description: This file contains auto-generated serialization and cloning codecs for F# collection types and F# choice types used within the Orleans serialization framework. It defines classes for serializing, deserializing, and deep copying F# options, lists, maps, sets, options, ref types, and choice types, as well as their surrogates and related utilities.
